patches.name: Clean share links
patches.description: Removes known tracking parameters and copies TikTok links without the promotional text.

patches.name: Hide feed ads
patches.description: Filters sponsored entries flagged by the MiniLite feed model.

patches.name: Hide inbox story tray
patches.description: Adds an off-by-default Mod settings switch to hide the stories tray in Inbox.

patches.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches.description: Adds an off-by-default Mod settings switch to hide suggested accounts in Profile and Inbox.

patches.name: Open mod settings from profile
patches.description: Adds a separate entry to open mod settings from the native settings page.

patches.name: Pause first video on launch
patches.description: Adds an off-by-default switch to pause the first For You video on a fresh app launch.

patches.name: Prefer clean source for video downloads
patches.description: Prefers the playback source for permitted saves when a playback URL is available.

patches.name: Show exact counts
patches.description: Adds an off-by-default switch in Mod settings to display full counts.

patches.name: Show video seekbar
patches.description: Adds an off-by-default switch in Mod settings to show the video timeline and seek in the feed.

patches.name: Stop video looping
patches.description: Adds an off-by-default switch in Mod settings to stop automatically repeating videos.
